provenance: New source translation; adjacent E2950-E2959 and E3040-E3049 reviewed.
context: Fiore kidnapped; Lady Marbas bids farewell before the final battle, then another quest branch has her summon the party through Tanya to find the Book of Keys.
decisions: Marbas reveals a voluptuous true form; preserve the sexual implication. Chu Lu Gah and escorts knowingly risked death. Cross-row clauses and questions retain breaks. Book of Keys provisional item wording.

translations.en: You hurried after them, but @7rFiore's@0r kidnappers
must have been very fast: they were nowhere to be seen.
Please save her!
Hurry! You've got to save her!
Lady Marbas
So, you're finally going to fight them?
I came to see you off. It might be the last time.
And I thought there was a little more about @7rChu Lu Gah@0r
that I should tell you.
I can see through certain secrets.
It's an ability I possess.
So I knew that when @7rChu Lu Gah@0r set out to seal the gateway,
he had already accepted that he would die.
And it wasn't just @7rChu Lu Gah@0r.
Everyone who went along to protect him
set out knowing they might die sealing that gateway.
Only the thief and a dying priest returned.
Before we parted, that thief told me something.
When the seal began to fail, hundreds of years later,
if some great fool decided to do something about it,
I was to lend them a hand...
I suppose you're that great fool.
Heh heh heh...
Listen. You must survive, whatever it takes.
If you live, people will speak of you as heroes.
And @7rChu Lu Gah@0r, now dismissed as some wretched bringer of curses,
can be vindicated: he closed this place to save the world,
and you can pass that truth down to future generations.
Now, let me meddle just a little more.
@7rGate Keeper@0r and @7rKey Master@0r
are near the center of this labyrinth's deepest level.
Don't waste a single action on the way there.
Take the shortest route possible, protect the seal,
and defeat @7rGate Keeper@0r and @7rKey Master@0r.
Understand? Make sure you come back.
If you do, I'm sure our paths will cross again.
I just have that feeling...
Off you go, then. Take care.
Could this be called a miasma?
A sinister, mistlike substance hung in the air,
creating an oppressively sickening atmosphere.
At the same time, something like an uncanny aura
pervaded the place, stronger than any you had ever felt.
It seems you have no choice but to proceed with caution.
I was told to wait here...
Huh? Why am I somewhere like this?!
The moment you entered @6rStrage Labyrinth@0r,
@7rTanya@0r changed completely, becoming her usual @7rTanya@0r self again.
Had something been controlling her?
As you looked around, a fairy appeared.
Have you been well, adventurers of @7rChu Lu Gah@0r?
There hovered @7rLady Marbas@0r, whom you had thought dead,
with a seductive smile on her face.
Hmm? I never died, you know.
When my magic runs dry, I return to my original form.
I stayed hidden until I could maintain this nimble form again.
@7rLady Marbas's@0r original form?
Does that mean this fairy shape is merely a disguise?
Could her real form be some demonic monster?
My true form is no monster, you know.
I have a wonderfully voluptuous body,
but humans lose all self-control when they see it.
That's why I take this fairy form,
and I've grown quite fond of it.
By the way, some time ago you found the key @7rChu Lu Gah@0r left,
didn't you?
I remembered hearing that instructions for that key
were hidden in this labyrinth.
To suggest you go and look for them,
I took control of that little girl peering into the labyrinth
and had her bring you here.
You'll certainly need them, won't you?
Now, let's start looking. The clue I remembered was
a @3rpainting of a burning hut@0r. Let's find that first.
It seems you have been pressed into searching for the @3rBook of Keys@0r
without being given a say in the matter.
Still, if there are instructions for that mysterious key,
you will certainly need them.
You decided to begin searching for the @3rBook of Keys@0r.
I have a feeling there's a treasure chest around here!
